title: Volume + Fibonacci + Trend + ATR Strategy with 1% Take Profit
title_zh: 成交量、斐波那契、趋势与 ATR 策略（固定 1% 止盈）
original_description: This version sets a **fixed 1% take profit** per trade. Ideal for **short-term traders** looking for quick gains.
description_zh: 此版本为每笔交易设置固定 1% 的止盈，面向希望较快获利的短线交易者。
crypto_relevance: 作者声明适用于加密、股票和外汇市场。
author: 11Muhil

title: Optimized Volume + Fibonacci + Trend + ATR Strategy
title_zh: 优化版成交量、斐波那契、趋势与 ATR 策略
original_description: This version **dynamically adjusts take profit** based on **market volatility (ATR)**. Best for **adaptive risk management**.
description_zh: 此版本根据市场波动性（ATR）动态调整止盈，适合自适应风险管理。
crypto_relevance: 作者声明适用于加密、股票和外汇市场。
author: 11Muhil
